2: One-off run: left Aiambak 8 AM 19 Nov with 1.2M L direct to Kiunga (ETA about 8 AM 22 Nov, 12 h discharging), back to Aiambak 25 Nov and on to POM (about 8 PM 29 Nov). Then normal POM–Aiambak trips at 1.5M L
3: Alongside at Aiambak with 1.5M L since 2 PM 18 Nov – tops up Amigo 1 as room becomes available, leaves about 8 AM 21 Nov. 1.5M L from next loading
4: Left Aiambak 17 Nov, returning to POM empty; held 1 day at POM, loads 1.5M L from 22 Nov
5: In POM; starts loading 1.0M L on 21 Nov (taken as midday), ETA Aiambak about midday 26 Nov
6: Delayed – laden with 1.0M L, now due at Kiunga about 7 AM 20 Nov; the only Aiambak–Kiunga relay vessel, loads first from Fly vessels and Diamond at Aiambak
7: Loading 950,000 L, departs 19 Nov to Aiambak (ETA 23 Nov) and refuels Elimbari there. Then shuttles POM–Aiambak: 1 day loading at POM, 4 days each way, 12 h discharging (to Elimbari when it's waiting, otherwise Amigo 1)
8: Shuttles POM–Aiambak, discharges 700,000 L into Amigo 1 each trip. 9-day cycle: at POM 1 day freight + 12 h loading CFO; 3 days to Aiambak; 12 h discharging CFO + 1 day freight; 3 days back. First loading 5 Dec
